name: Structural Analyser
mechanics: Darkstrider's ranged attacks apply Markerlight for one round.
Adjacent friendly units gain ranged damage against Markerlight targets.
Friendly Tau Empire units within two hexes also gain the ranged damage bonus.
breakpoint_notes: Value depends on Markerlight uptime and keeping ranged attackers in the supported area.

sources.notes: Current passive ability text after the July and December 2025 changes.
